purpose: This form is used for an application under section 14 for the conversion of a public company into a private company.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Within sixty days from the date of passing of special resolution
steps: Pass a special resolution authorising the alteration for conversion.
Prepare the e-Form No. RD-1 application with all required particulars and documents.
File the application with the Regional Director within sixty days from the date of passing the special resolution.
checklist: e-Memorandum of Association and e-Articles of Association with proposed alterations.
A copy of the minutes of the general meeting with special resolution and vote details.
A copy of Board resolution or Power of Attorney dated not earlier than thirty days.
Declaration by a key managerial personnel or director regarding member limit and deposits.
Declaration by a key managerial personnel or director regarding compliance with specified sections.
Declaration by a key managerial personnel or director regarding pending resolutions and listing history.
attachments: e-Memorandum of Association and e-Articles of Association with proposed alterations
Copy of the minutes of the general meeting with votes and names of dissenters
Copy of Board resolution or Power of Attorney authorising to file application
Declaration by a key managerial personnel or director regarding member limit and deposits
Declaration by a key managerial personnel or director regarding non-compliance
Declaration by a key managerial personnel or director regarding pending resolutions and delisting
watch: Ensure the application is filed within sixty days from the date of passing the special resolution.
